scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Long time no see!
Hey, you didn't quit
your business, did you?
What happened?
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
好久不见！
嘿，你该不会不做生意了吧？
发生什么事了？

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Whoa...
You've actually been to Valhalla?! Wow, you've come a long way...
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
哇...
你竟然去过瓦尔哈拉？！
真是经历了不少事啊...

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Hmmm...
It seems that you're not ready to become a Merchant again. Go finish learning the Basic Novice Skills first.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
嗯...
看来你还没准备好重新成为商人。
先去把初心者基础技能学完吧。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Don't worry, we'll always have a Merchant position open for you. Just come back when you're ready, okay?
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
别担心，我们始终为你留着商人的位置。
准备好了就回来，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
I guess it's destiny that we meet like this once more. Alright. Once again, let me change you into a Merchant!
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
看来，我们能这样再次相遇，也是命运的安排。
好，再让我为你转职成商人吧！

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Ah~ How nostalgic. Just like old times! Alright, do your best!
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
啊~真让人怀念，就像回到了从前！
好了，好好努力吧！

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
^333333*Sigh*^000000
I'm so bored...
When will I hear from my lovely Blossom?
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
^333333*叹气*^000000
好无聊啊...
什么时候才能收到我可爱的布洛森的消息呢？

scripts.text:
[Guildsman Mahnsoo]
Hey, why are you here?
scripts.translation:
[公会成员 曼苏]
嘿，你在这里做什么？

scripts.text: I want to be a merchant.
scripts.translation: 我想成为商人

scripts.text: I want to know more about merchants.
scripts.translation: 我想多了解一下商人

scripts.text: Ask him the requirements to be a merchant.
scripts.translation: 询问成为商人的条件

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 没什么

scripts.text:
[Guildsman Mahnsoo]
Ahh? Are you trying to have both ways?
How about just giving yourself over to your original job?
scripts.translation:
[公会成员 曼苏]
啊？你想两头都占吗？
还是安心做好你原来的职业吧？

scripts.text:
[Guildsman Mahnsoo]
.....? Sorry? What are you saying?
You are already a merchant. Oh my..
Huh?! ...Do I need to laugh right now?!
scripts.translation:
[公会成员 曼苏]
......？什么？你在说什么？
你已经是商人了啊。天哪...
什么？！...我现在该笑吗？！

scripts.text:
[Guildsman Mahnsoo]
Want to be a merchant? Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[公会成员 曼苏]
想成为商人？嗯...

scripts.text:
[Guildsman Mahnsoo]
We have business ethics you know.
scripts.translation:
[公会成员 曼苏]
我们可是讲究商业道德的。

scripts.text:
[Guildsman Mahnsoo]
But if you want to be a merchant, your basic skill level must reach Level 9 or you must spend all of your skill points.
scripts.translation:
[公会成员 曼苏]
不过，如果你想成为商人，基本技能等级必须达到9级，也就是要用完所有的技能点。

scripts.text:
[Guildsman Mahnsoo]
Don't you think we need to learn some basic skills although we just deal with money?
scripts.translation:
[公会成员 曼苏]
虽然我们只是跟钱打交道，但你不觉得还是需要学点基本技能吗？

scripts.text:
[Guildsman Mahnsoo]
Good, I think you're fully ready for it seeing that your basic skill level is fulfilled.
Now I allow you to be a merchant.
scripts.translation:
[公会成员 曼苏]
很好，看来你的基本技能等级已经达标，完全准备好了。
现在，我准许你成为商人。

scripts.text:
[Guildsman Mahnsoo]
Congratulations on becoming a merchant!
Congratulations again for being a member of the merchant guild and one of our colleagues. I expect your active participation from now on!
scripts.translation:
[公会成员 曼苏]
恭喜你成为商人！
再次恭喜你成为商人公会的一员，成为我们的同伴。期待你今后的活跃表现！

scripts.text:
[Guildsman Mahnsoo]
Absolutely, we need young people who have passion to achieve our great goal for securing 20% of the worldwide currency volume. You get it? Huh?
Well, I'm just saying... it means let's make lots of money in the end. You guys know that~
scripts.translation:
[公会成员 曼苏]
没错，我们需要充满热情的年轻人，来实现占据全球货币流通量20%的伟大目标。懂吗？嗯？
好吧，我只是说说...意思就是最终要赚大钱。你们懂的~

scripts.text:
[Guildsman Mahnsoo]
Merchant? To put it simply, the person who sells good and makes money is a merchant.
Not good at fighting and doesn't have special attack/recovery skills... but a merchant can buy things at a low price and then sell them and make money.
scripts.translation:
[公会成员 曼苏]
商人？简单来说，就是卖东西赚钱的人。
不擅长战斗，也没有特别的攻击或恢复技能...但商人可以低价买进，再卖出赚钱。

scripts.text:
[Guildsman Mahnsoo]
Well, a merchant has an ultimate skill called Mammonite which strikes an enemy with his/her money... We can equip everything except Bows, Rods, and Two-Handed Swords. But we can always sell and buy those.
Yes... we merchants always have money on our minds, got it?
scripts.translation:
[公会成员 曼苏]
嗯，商人有一个叫金钱攻击的终极技能，用金钱攻击敌人...除了弓、杖和双手剑，我们什么都能装备。不过那些我们随时都可以买卖。
没错...我们商人满脑子都是钱，懂吗？

scripts.text:
[Guildsman Mahnsoo]
To become a merchant, although just selling and receiving money is our job, you must reach at least basic skill level 9.
scripts.translation:
[公会成员 曼苏]
虽然我们的工作只是卖东西收钱，但要成为商人，基本技能等级至少要达到9级。

scripts.text:
[Guildsman Mahnsoo]
Well, we used to receive a start-up fee before. Wasn't it hard to make that money?
There were too many people who couldn't gather that money and kept crying.
scripts.translation:
[公会成员 曼苏]
嗯，我们以前要收开业费。那笔钱很难攒吧？
有太多人凑不齐那笔钱，一直哭哭啼啼的。

scripts.text:
[Guildsman Mahnsoo]
So recently, we decided to allow any Novice who wants to be a merchant become one.
Because to be alive or not later is all up to one's ability.
scripts.translation:
[公会成员 曼苏]
所以最近，我们决定让所有想当商人的初心者都能转职。
因为以后能不能活下去，全靠个人的本事。
